item: Second A-036 fold: four same-name helpers that differed only in a name, a constant or a docstring (import_owns_the_machine x2, rss_mb x2, read_jsonl_tail x2, serve tri-state x2) move to src/shared.py (R494)
summary: Audit A-036 second fold: eight private copies in eight files became four shared helpers, behaviour unchanged (src/shared.py: import_owns_the_machine, rss_mb, read_jsonl_tail, tri_state; psutil and the scheduler are imported inside the calls so the module stays stdlib-only at module level). Old private names stay as aliases or one-line wrappers because tests monkeypatch them and test_swap_barrier reads _import_owns_the_machine() in source; recent_results keeps each module's own default limit (500 field_test, 1000 feed_preflight) and its own _log_path; each serve_mode keeps its own variable (OO_COLUMNAR_MAP_SERVE / OO_COLUMNAR_SERVE). The same-name pairs in fts_reindex and keyword_fold are NOT this helper (they also check holds_exclusive) and stay. Left for their owners: the ledger pair and file_lock (WAL), the analytics hunk touched by the analytics lane. Tests pin the divisor of rss_mb with a fake psutil and cross-talk between the two serves in both directions.
